SET_RACE.start_frame: WORKSPACE_START_FRAME = 0 (first supported frame; matches useReplay.selectRace reset)
SET_RACE.driver: carried only if roster supplied and contains it, else null

SEEK_FRAME.rule: exact valid frame only; out-of-range/non-integer rejected with INVALID_FRAME; no clamp, no snap
SEEK_FRAME.unknown_domain: shape check only (integer >= 0); range deferred to adapter at request time

SELECT_DRIVER.rule: exact identity; empty rejected; known-nonmember (roster supplied, absent) rejected with INVALID_DRIVER; unknown membership (roster null) accepted (evidence != identity)

HYDRATE_FROM_URL.rule: strict parse; no silent snapping; failure is typed MALFORMED_URL

start_frame_rule: first supported frame (frame 0). Evidence: useReplay.selectRace resets setFrameIndex(0); deep-linked ?frame= applies to the first race only (initialFrameAppliedRef). No future-data optimization.
event_primitive: eventSeek(state, frameIndex, totalFrames): future event objects resolve to exact frameIndex through this single entry; no event objects/state in B
timeline_primitive: timelineSeek(state, frameIndex, totalFrames): (canonical frameIndex, valid domain) -> exact seekFrame; no visual timeline changes in B

error_model.behavior: typed results, never throw, never coerce; bad query params record errors without crashing

causal_boundary: workspace state carries identity only (race/frame/driver) — no scientific payloads, no prefetch of future frames/scientific data; downstream modules remain responsible for causal gating at T
presentation_separation: canonical type has exactly 3 keys; provider exposes only setRace/seekFrame/selectDriver/clearDriver; drawers/tabs/hover/sort stay local (pinned by integrity tests)
